scope: Intrinsic Firefox versus Chrome setup cost on the same final-main official GNU binary. Mandatory capability sets differ; this is not a cross-revision non-regression claim.
statisticalPolicy: Retain all qualified-collector bootstrap95 intervals and all samples; no pooling or selective reruns. Report profile-dependent cost without applying same-capability regression guards to different browser capabilities. Require complete integrity, all batches, zero collector failures and exact CPU restoration. This diagnostic cannot substitute for the separately guarded final-main default-Chrome non-regression campaign.
host: Same fixed 2.4GHz P-core policies, affinity 0,2,4,6 and isolated netns; sequential after protected campaign, no simultaneous compiler/archive workload.
